descripcion: School furniture: classroom, library, canteen, gym, playground, music, computer room and corridors.

subcategorias.paredes_aula: Boards and things hanging in the classroom
subcategorias.suelo_aula: Corners and things on the floor

pupitre.descripcion: Pupil's desk with its chair behind. A classroom has many, in rows with aisles between them.
pupitre.imagen: Footprint of “School desk”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pu”.

pupitre_doble.descripcion: Desk for two pupils, with two chairs.
pupitre_doble.imagen: Footprint of “Double school desk”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pd”.

mesa_del_profesor.descripcion: Large desk with drawers, in front of the board and facing the pupils' desks.
mesa_del_profesor.imagen: Footprint of “Teacher's desk”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Md”.

silla.descripcion: Light school chair, tubular steel and plywood. It scrapes noisily when moved.
silla.imagen: Footprint of “Pupil's chair”: a rectangle, 0.42 by 0.42 metres, marked with the letters “Si”.

pizarra.descripcion: Board hung on the wall, from waist height to above the head, with a chalk ledge that sticks out.
pizarra.imagen: Footprint of “Board”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.08 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pi”.

armario.descripcion: Tall two-door cupboard where materials are kept.
armario.imagen: Footprint of “Classroom cupboard”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

estanteria_baja.descripcion: Low shelving with pigeonholes for the pupils' trays.
estanteria_baja.imagen: Footprint of “Low classroom shelves”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Eb”.

papelera.descripcion: Small plastic bin. It tips over if you push it.
papelera.imagen: Footprint of “Waste bin”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

reciclaje.descripcion: Three bins side by side for paper, packaging and general waste, with swing lids.
reciclaje.imagen: Footprint of “Classroom recycling bins”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Re”.

mesa_redonda.descripcion: Round table for group work, with chairs around it.
mesa_redonda.imagen: Footprint of “Round group table”: a circle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

mesa_hexagonal.descripcion: Six-sided table, one side per pupil.
mesa_hexagonal.imagen: Footprint of “Hexagonal group table”: a hexagon, 1.30 by 1.13 metres, marked with the letters “Mh”.

alfombra_asamblea.descripcion: Large round rug in the nursery circle-time corner. You walk on it: steps sound muffled.
alfombra_asamblea.imagen: Footprint of “Circle-time rug”: a circle, 2.50 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

mochilas.descripcion: Schoolbags left in the aisle between desks. A low, soft obstacle: here today, gone tomorrow.
mochilas.imagen: Footprint of “Schoolbags on the floor”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.60 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Mo”.

estanteria_biblioteca.descripcion: Free-standing double-sided shelving full of books. Between two of them there is a narrow aisle.
estanteria_biblioteca.imagen: Footprint of “Library shelving”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Eb”.

mesa_lectura.descripcion: Long library table for several readers.
mesa_lectura.imagen: Footprint of “Reading table”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ml”.

mesa_ordenador.descripcion: Desk with a screen, keyboard and the tower underneath. The computer hums softly when on.
mesa_ordenador.imagen: Footprint of “Computer desk”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mo”.

impresora.descripcion: Large printer on its stand, at waist height.
impresora.imagen: Footprint of “Printer”: a rectangle, 0.55 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Im”.

carrito.descripcion: Wheeled trolley loaded with books or laptops. It turns up in any corridor and rolls if pushed.
carrito.imagen: Footprint of “Book trolley”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

mesa_comedor.descripcion: Long canteen table with a fixed bench on each side, all in one piece. You get in by stepping over the bench.
mesa_comedor.imagen: Footprint of “Canteen table with benches”: a long rectangle: the table in the middle and a fixed bench along each side, 2.40 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

linea_bandejas.descripcion: Long steel counter with a rail in front to slide your tray along.
linea_bandejas.imagen: Footprint of “Serving counter”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Lb”.

carro_bandejas.descripcion: Tall metal trolley with runners where used trays are left.
carro_bandejas.imagen: Footprint of “Tray trolley”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

fuente_agua.descripcion: Steel fountain at waist height. Press the button and a jet comes out to drink from.
fuente_agua.imagen: Footprint of “Drinking fountain”: a rectangle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Fa”.

colchoneta.descripcion: Thick mat on the floor. You step onto it: the floor gives and steps make no sound.
colchoneta.imagen: Footprint of “Gym mat”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

potro.descripcion: Vaulting horse: a padded body on four legs, at chest height.
potro.imagen: Footprint of “Vaulting horse”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.40 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Po”.

plinto.descripcion: Stacked wooden boxes, wider at the bottom than at the top, with a padded lid.
plinto.imagen: Footprint of “Vaulting box”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.80 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pl”.

espalderas.descripcion: Horizontal wooden bars fixed to the wall, from the floor to over two metres. They stick out a hand's width.
espalderas.imagen: Footprint of “Wall bars”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

banco_sueco.descripcion: Long, low, narrow wooden bench. At shin height: easy to trip over.
banco_sueco.imagen: Footprint of “Gym bench”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Bs”.

canasta.descripcion: Basketball hoop: a wide, heavy base on the floor and a post rising to the backboard, well above head height.
canasta.imagen: Footprint of “Basketball hoop”: a T shape, 1.20 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

porteria.descripcion: Futsal goal: two posts and a crossbar, with the net behind. You can walk in from the front.
porteria.imagen: Footprint of “Goal”: a U open at the front: the two posts and the net behind, 3.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Po”.

mesa_pimpon.descripcion: Table tennis table with its net across the middle. Large, hard-edged, at hip height.
mesa_pimpon.imagen: Footprint of “Table tennis table”: a rectangle, 1.52 by 2.74 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

banco_vestuario.descripcion: Slatted bench with a rail of coat hooks above it, at head height.
banco_vestuario.imagen: Footprint of “Changing room bench”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.

tobogan.descripcion: Playground slide: the ladder at the back and the metal chute coming down to the front.
tobogan.imagen: Footprint of “Slide”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.60 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “To”.

arenero.descripcion: Low enclosure full of sand. Step over the edge to get in; inside, your steps sink.
arenero.imagen: Footprint of “Sandpit”: a rectangle with cut corners, 3.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

piano.descripcion: Upright piano in the music room. Touch it and three notes sound.
piano.imagen: Footprint of “Upright piano”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pi”.

instrumentos.descripcion: Low shelves with tambourines, triangles and drums. Jog it and everything rattles.
instrumentos.imagen: Footprint of “Instrument rack”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “In”.

atril.descripcion: Metal music stand: a tripod at the bottom and the tray at chest height. Light and easily knocked over.
atril.imagen: Footprint of “Music stand”: a triangle (the three legs), 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “At”.

tarima.descripcion: Wooden platform a hand's width high. You step up onto it: it is a step, and footsteps on it sound hollow.
tarima.imagen: Footprint of “Platform”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

taquillas.descripcion: Row of tall sheet-metal lockers against the wall. They clang when hit.
taquillas.imagen: Footprint of “Lockers”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

percheros.descripcion: Rail of hooks on the corridor wall, at shoulder height, bulky with coats and bags.
percheros.imagen: Footprint of “Wall coat hooks”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pe”.

banco_pasillo.descripcion: Wooden bench against the corridor wall.
banco_pasillo.imagen: Footprint of “Corridor bench”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

tablon.descripcion: Framed cork noticeboard hung at mid height. It barely sticks out from the wall.
tablon.imagen: Footprint of “Noticeboard”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.04 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ta”.

columna.descripcion: Concrete column in the way. Hard and cold; no warning until you touch it.
columna.imagen: Footprint of “Column”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

pilar_cuadrado.descripcion: Square brick pillar with four sharp corners.
pilar_cuadrado.imagen: Footprint of “Square pillar”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

extintor.descripcion: Fire extinguisher hung on the wall one metre up. The cane passes under it.
extintor.imagen: Footprint of “Wall fire extinguisher”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ex”.

vitrina_trofeos.descripcion: Glass cabinet with cups and medals inside. The glass chinks when touched.
vitrina_trofeos.imagen: Footprint of “Trophy cabinet”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Vt”.

mapa_mural.descripcion: Canvas map hanging from a roller above the board; pulled down, its lower edge with a wooden rod is at chest height and swings when brushed. The cane does not find it.
mapa_mural.imagen: Footprint of “Pull-down wall map”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.05 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Mm”.

reloj_aula.descripcion: Round clock hung above the door or the board, well above head height. You cannot touch it, but in silence its tick is audible and tells you which wall the door is on.
reloj_aula.imagen: Footprint of “Classroom wall clock”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.05 metres, hanging 2.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ra”.

panel_interactivo_ruedas.nombre: Interactive display on a wheeled stand
panel_interactivo_ruedas.descripcion: Huge touch screen on a metal stand with two long feet reaching forward. The feet, at floor level, stick out further than the screen; when on, a fan whirs.
panel_interactivo_ruedas.imagen: Footprint of “Interactive display on a wheeled stand”: a U open at the front, 1.95 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pi”.

ventilador_techo.descripcion: Blades turning, hung from the ceiling well above head height. You cannot touch them, but you hear them spinning and feel the draught on your face: they mark the middle of the room.
ventilador_techo.imagen: Footprint of “Ceiling fan”: a 4-pointed star, 1.30 by 1.30 metres, hanging 2.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Vt”.

purificador_aire.descripcion: Plastic column at hip height in a corner of the classroom, with a grille on top that blows air. It hums steadily and softly; if switched off, the room sounds different.
purificador_aire.imagen: Footprint of “Air purifier”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.40 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

mesa_trapecio.descripcion: Pupils' table shaped like a trapezoid: one long side, one short and two slanted. Two together make a hexagon; the slanted corners are confusing when you trace the edge by hand.
mesa_trapecio.imagen: Footprint of “Trapezoid table”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

cordel_dibujos.descripcion: String stretched from wall to wall across the classroom, with drawings held by pegs. It hangs at face height and the papers brush your head; the cane passes underneath with no warning.
cordel_dibujos.imagen: Footprint of “String of hanging drawings”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cd”.

triangulo_pikler.descripcion: Two wooden slatted ladders joined at the top like a tent, at a child's chest height. Children climb up one side and down the other; the spread legs are easy to trip on.
triangulo_pikler.imagen: Footprint of “Pikler climbing triangle”: an open V: two slatted ladders meeting at the top, 0.80 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

teclado_soporte.descripcion: Electric keyboard resting on a tubular X-shaped stand. The stand is light and folds if pushed; the legs of the X stick out underneath.
teclado_soporte.imagen: Footprint of “Keyboard on an X-stand”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ts”.

gradas_coro.descripcion: Three wide wooden steps in a fan shape, where the choir sings standing up. Each step rises a hand's width and sounds hollow underfoot; the top edge has no railing.
gradas_coro.imagen: Footprint of “Choir risers”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 3.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Gc”.

mesa_plegable_taburetes.descripcion: Canteen table with round stools fixed to its frame, on wheels: it folds upright to clear the room. Open, the stools stick out on both sides at knee height.
mesa_plegable_taburetes.imagen: Footprint of “Folding table with stools”: a table top with round stools sticking out on both sides, 2.40 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

balones_sueltos.descripcion: Balls left rolling around the court or playground. You step on them and they slip away, and the cane sends them rolling off: here today, somewhere else tomorrow.
balones_sueltos.imagen: Footprint of “Loose balls on the floor”: a few scattered patches, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bs”.

baul_recreo.descripcion: Large hard plastic or wooden chest against the playground wall, holding skipping ropes, hoops, balls and chalk. The lid is heavy and slams shut.
baul_recreo.imagen: Footprint of “Playground toy chest”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

bancal_huerto.descripcion: Bottomless box of planks at knee height, filled with soil and plants. The wooden edge is found with the cane; inside, the soil is soft and sometimes wet.
bancal_huerto.imagen: Footprint of “School garden raised bed”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bh”.

compostera.descripcion: Plastic or slatted box the size of a large bin, with a lid on top and a hatch at the bottom. It smells of damp earth and the lid sounds hollow.
compostera.imagen: Footprint of “Compost bin”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

estacion_meteorologica.descripcion: Metal mast on spread legs, with the rain gauge halfway up and the anemometer cups at the top, which spin and click when it is windy.
estacion_meteorologica.imagen: Footprint of “School weather station”: a cross: the mast in the middle and the legs spreading to four sides, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

deposito_lluvia.descripcion: Large barrel under the gutter, with a tap at the bottom to fill watering cans. Knocking it, it sounds fuller or emptier; the ground around it is usually wet.
deposito_lluvia.imagen: Footprint of “Rain water butt”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Dl”.

comedero_pajaros.descripcion: Little house or tube of seed hung from a branch or hook at head height. It swings when brushed; nearby you hear birds coming to feed.
comedero_pajaros.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging bird feeder”: a house-shaped pentagon, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cp”.

timbre_escolar.descripcion: Round metal bell screwed high on the corridor or playground wall. It rings loudly at the start and end of every lesson and break: from almost anywhere you can tell where it is.
timbre_escolar.imagen: Footprint of “School bell”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 0.20 by 0.10 metres, hanging 2.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Te”.

cajon_objetos_perdidos.descripcion: Large plastic box or a rail in a corner of the caretaker's area, full of forgotten sweatshirts, lunch boxes and bottles. Soft to touch; there is always something inside.
cajon_objetos_perdidos.imagen: Footprint of “Lost property box”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

contenedor_tapones.descripcion: Heart-shaped wire mesh cage, taller than a child, filled with plastic bottle caps for charity. Drop one in and you hear it rattle down among the rest.
contenedor_tapones.imagen: Footprint of “Bottle cap heart bin”: a heart pointing to the front, 0.90 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

secadero_dibujos.descripcion: Wire rack on wheels at chest height, with many thin mesh shelves where painted drawings are left to dry. The shelves lift on springs and bounce.
secadero_dibujos.imagen: Footprint of “Art drying rack”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Sd”.

pila_plastica.descripcion: Deep steel or ceramic sink on a cabinet, with two taps, for washing brushes and pots. The floor around it is usually splashed and slippery.
pila_plastica.imagen: Footprint of “Art room deep sink”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

urinarios_fila.descripcion: Ceramic urinals hung on the wall in a row, with dividers between them sticking out at hip height. You count them by the dividers; the floor in front may be wet.
urinarios_fila.imagen: Footprint of “Row of urinals”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 2.00 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Uf”.

cabinas_inodoro.descripcion: Row of compact laminate cubicles, each with a door and a gap at the bottom between the panel and the floor. The doors open inwards and close with a clicking latch.
cabinas_inodoro.imagen: Footprint of “Toilet cubicles”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 2.70 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ci”.

columpio_sensorial.descripcion: Lycra pod or platform hung by a rope from a ceiling hook, at knee height. It sways and turns in any direction; there is a mat underneath.

cortina_fibras_opticas.imagen: Footprint of “Fibre optic curtain”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

bipedestador.descripcion: Frame with a wide U-shaped base and a tray at the front at chest height, where a pupil who cannot stand unaided spends time upright held by straps. Heavy; the base sticks out at floor level.
